messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: log-alert 'embed-service-5xx-surge' fired (severity: page). 1786 matches in last 1m. Pager: @sasha. Incident URL: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1876543210

sasha: taking it. Oncall for the hour.

maria: grabbing logs now, looks like a spike of 502s from embed route /v1/embeddings/batch. Possibly timeout cascade to proxy.

alex: seeing a ton of this in logs: "upstream error: ECONNRESET while writing" repeated with client ip 10.45.x.x range. Could be a low-level pod restart flurry.

sasha: posting quick triage checklist: 1) confirm customer impact, 2) remove noisy alerts or suppress while we mitigate, 3) apply short-term rule tweak, 4) restore and roll back changes.

runbook-bot: Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/embed-502s — follow '502 surge' section.

maria: customer-impact check: Querying APM traces now. So far 3 customer API keys show elevated 5xx rates, total failed requests ~1.2k in last 5m. Customer-facing latency spike ~4-7s.

alex: infra note: control-plane reports 4 worker pods restarted in last 2m (OOMKilled). Might be batching memory spike.

sasha: ok, to avoid noisy paging while we stabilize i'm going to temporarily adjust the alert threshold and add a regex filter for known internal probe errors. Will create a quick ticket/PR for the change.

maria: agree. we should not silence everything — keep alerting on error-rate > 2% for >=5m once mitigated. For live mitigation: increase threshold to 1.5% for 2m and add rule-level mute for probe-user-agent.

sasha: executing: patching alert rule to exclude `user_agent=^redwood-healthz` and bump threshold. Pasting change below:

```yaml
# log-alert: embed-service-5xx-surge
query: |
  source: logs
  where service = "embed-service"
    and status >= 500
    and not user_agent =~ /redwood-healthz/  # ignore internal probe
aggregate: count()
condition: count() > 1500 for 2m  # temporary live-mitigation
```

alex: that regex drop should remove the probe noise. Also add signature for `ECONNRESET while writing` so we can later split out upstream vs app errors.

maria: creating signature now: `sig: embed-upstream-connreset` pattern `ECONNRESET`. Will attach to existing alert so it can bucket matches.

sasha: applied patch and muted old alerting channel for 15m. CI ran, PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/alerts/pull/542 (draft, auto-merge after 1h).

maria: spinning up one extra replica in the embed-service ASG as a quick capacity buffer. Command: `kubectl scale deploy/embed-service --replicas=5`

alex: observed immediate drop in 5xx rate after scaling and probe exclusion. Current failed requests down to ~320 in last 5m. Latency improving.

sasha: customer impact notes to capture for postmortem: - window: 1876543140 — 1876543400 (~4.3m) - affected endpoints: /v1/embeddings/batch - approx 3 customers, estimated error-rate peak 6% for those keys - mitigation steps: probe exclusion, temporary threshold bump, scale up 1 replica - risk: change was temporary; must revert after stabilization and create a longer-term fix (memory/quantization tuning).

maria: creating follow-up ticket for dashboards: add a per-key error-rate heatmap and a split by `upstream-error` signature. Also add widget for OOM events on embed nodes.

alex: I'll open a runtime task to audit KV cache/quantization memory use. Suspect a batch-size edge-case caused oom.

jane: taking the handoff at 19:30 UTC. Leaving checklist: monitor alert 'embed-service-5xx-surge' for next 2h, ensure PR 542 merges after validation, rollback change if error-rate back to normal for 30m.

sasha: handoff notes posted in ticket: https://boards.redwood.ai/board/ENG/12345. Leaving runbook steps. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

runbook-bot: Incident closed for paging (manual suppress). Post-incident actions: 1) formal postmortem, 2) add regex to permanent alert rule, 3) add signature-based rerouting in console, 4) schedule runtime memory audit.

maria: I'll draft the postmortem and include suggested alert tuning rules + dashboard mockups.

sasha: since we changed alert thresholds temporarily, make sure to document the exact YAML diff in the postmortem (PR 542).

alex: note for postmortem: include cost/latency delta from autoscaling and the exact PODOOM logs (attached to ticket).

jane: acknowledged, I'll keep an eye overnight and ping if anything regresses. Good catch all.

inc-bot: Incident page updated: https://incidents.redwood.ai/1876543210 - status: mitigated, pages silenced.
